bio.title: Software Engineer
paragraphs: Software Engineer specializing in the architecture and development of robust enterprise security solutions, secure backend systems, and comprehensive DevOps integrations.
Over 4 years of experience driving backend development, security engineering, and cross-platform solutions.
Proven track record of building secure credential automation pipelines, enhancing password vault workflows, and delivering highly scalable engineering platforms at Securden.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: PAM • AD/Azure/Google Workspace • DevOps Integrations • Password Self-Service • API
achievements: Architected and built an enterprise-grade Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) platform with multi-directory support, focusing on high availability and secure architecture.
Engineered robust Password Vault workflows, implementing Just-In-Time (JIT) access, complex approval chains, and secure, policy-based access controls.
Developed secure architectural integrations for major identity providers, including Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Active Directory, ensuring seamless and safe data synchronization.
Built and maintained custom infrastructure plugins for Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet to enable secure CRUD operations on secrets within CI/CD pipelines.
Enhanced secure browser extension, creating encrypted and user-friendly credential autofill ecosystem.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
achievements: Mentored junior developers to deliver scalable backend solutions, successfully navigating complex technical requirements across diverse tech stacks.
Designed and implemented backend operational workflows, delivering production-ready features for a high-traffic SaaS platform and a Student Management System.
Spearheaded the rebuilding of legacy software and websites, with minimal resources to significantly improve overall system efficiency and modernizing the UI/UX.
Architected and single-handedly developed a custom internal project management tool to streamline organizational workflows, task tracking, and team collaboration.

jobs.title: Software Engineer

items.title: GrantBase.gov.in – SIH Winner
items.description: Built a government research grant intelligence platform that fetches real-time grant data from multiple portals. Engineered the backend to provide domain-based recommendations and automated alerts for researchers.

items.title: Web Automation for Academic Data Entry
items.description: Developed an automation platform to parse Excel data and automatically populate student records into the OASIS college portal, completely eliminating manual data entry tasks for administrative staff.

items.title: LEGALTECH – Software Implementation in Law firms
items.description: Engineered a platform bridging legal professionals and clients. Built backend features allowing lawyers to manage case records securely and enabling users to find advocates based on historical case data.
